metadata.paired_test: state-level MSE difference (single - collective); the n_states delta(s) are iid so z=mean/SE is valid.  Winner called at |z| > 2, else 'tie'.  Noise is modelled only on the collective route, so single and collective per-state MSE are ~independent (pairing is a valid framing, not a power gain).  No family-wise correction across cells; the 12 (noise,rate) cells at fixed (ensemble,n) share the single-copy sample so are positively correlated; boundaries at |z| < 3 are flagged 'ambiguous'.  RMSE intervals are 68% bootstrap over states.
